scope: Collector source implementation only; paper/research data. No deployment, Pantheon intake or hosted acceptance claim.
transport: Production CLI path: python -m collector_stack.cli run --source collector-tw-taifex-vix, LiveScraplingTransport (scrapling==0.2.99 installed in a throwaway venv, raw httpx bytes), single connection, 5s spacing, throwaway salt file.

confirmed_urls.format: Big5 (cp950) tab text, CRLF; header 交易日期/時間(時/分/秒/毫秒)/臺指選擇權波動率指數/收盤前1分鐘平均指數, then dash rule; one row per session at 13:45; current month + 3 prior months (4 files at 2026-11-14: 202608-202611)

Big5 tab text, one file per session day, 15-second rows (time H[H]MMSSff, e.g. 9001500=09:00:15.00), final line "Last 1 min AVG"; unknown date returns HTTP 200 HTML (treated as format change); download link is a plain onClick window.open, page is server-rendered
zip, members named tvix_YYYYMMDD (no extension), same Big5 intraday format; 3 zips at 2026-11-14: 202608-202610

robots: https://www.taifex.com.tw/robots.txt returns a 404 HTML page (no rules)
second_run_note: Ledger skipped 16 finished files; only the still-growing current-month daily file (new content hash if changed, otherwise same item id) was requested again, plus the 3 listing pages.

failed_closed_probe.note: Initial time parser assumed 3-digit ms; live data uses 2-digit fraction. The run failed closed with zero rows and no ledger update; parser fixed.

fixtures.recording: Complete unedited Big5 file downloaded with curl on 2026-11-14 (daily=month file 202611; intraday=getVixData 20261113)

tests: deploy/collector tests: 219 passed, 2 skipped (pytest in a throwaway venv)

contracts.ledger: <root>/state/taifex-vix/ledger.json, advanced only after the bundle is published
contracts.downstream_intake: out of scope; opened with the regime engine work

limits: A full session file has 1141 time rows (09:00:00 to 13:45:00 every 15 s) plus the Last 1 min AVG line, which is kept as last_1min_avg and is not a time row.
Month zips for the current month do not exist until the month ends; days not yet in a zip come from getVixData while listed on vixMinNew.
